raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.29.4"
  python_check_max: "3.14"
  unlink_tests: test_build_backend.py

package:
  name: pyproject-fmt
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/pyproject-fmt/pyproject_fmt-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: fc1fdd0f5ab1b07ac6a4f4e0f30444a2d7c8f2965d2e574641d0bebc784f01b0

build:
  number: 0
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
      CARGO: cargo-auditable-wrapper${{ ".bat" if win }}
      PYTHONIOENCODING: utf-8
      PYTHONLEGACYTEXTENCODING: utf-8
    content:
      - if: win
        then:
          - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat" "%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
        else:
          - cp "${RECIPE_DIR}/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh" "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
          - chmod 755 "${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper"
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
  python:
    entry_points:
      - pyproject-fmt = pyproject_fmt.__main__:runner
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-auditable
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - maturin >=1.15
    - pip
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then:
        - python-abi3
  run:
    - python
    - toml-fmt-common

tests:
  - if: is_abi3
    then:
      - python:
          imports: pyproject_fmt
          pip_check: true
          python_version:
            - ${{ python_min }}.*
            - ${{ python_check_max }}.*
    else:
      - python:
          imports: pyproject_fmt
          pip_check: true
  - files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
      source:
        - pyproject-fmt/tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest >=8.4.2
        - pytest-cov >=7
        - pytest-mock >=3.15.1
        - trove-classifiers >=2026.6.1.19
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - abi3audit
            - python !=${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - pyproject-fmt --help
      - python -c "import os; [os.unlink(f'pyproject-fmt/tests/{p}') for p in '''${{ unlink_tests }}'''.split()]"
      - python run_test.py --python-min=${{ python_min }}

about:
  summary: Format your pyproject.toml file
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/pyproject-fmt
  repository: https://github.com/tox-dev/toml-fmt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bollwyvl
